topic: Protecting and conserving the environment for living things
key_concepts: All living things have basic needs: food, water, air, sunlight, and shelter.
Living things depend on a healthy environment to meet their basic needs and survive.
Human activities can threaten or destroy the environment.
Pollution makes air, water, or land dirty.
Throwing trash like plastic bags and bottles into water harms or kills water animals.
Factories and farms release harmful chemicals into bodies of water, poisoning the water.
Acid rain forms when smoke from factories and cars mixes with rain.
Acid rain can harm plants and animals.
Changes in the environment can affect the growth of plants.
